title: My cautious optimism has been - and continues to be - based on 1). Heat remains most aggressive suitor. 2). Several teams who could top a Heat offer either decided against it or were deterred by Giannis' unwillingness to sign longterm there. 3). Giannis strongly wanting Miami, and he has some influence on this process.... The reasons why nobody should be 'certain' this happens with Miami: 1). Celtics will always loom as threat because Giannis would be OK with that. 2). You can't predict the behavior of rich men. What if Bucks owners say, 'Heat offer is not good enough. [Bleep] everybody! We're keeping him!' 3). There's always the threat of mystery team, but with knowledge that a team wouldn't bid a ton without knowledge that Giannis would be willing to stay longterm. Nothing groundbreaking in this post, but that largely covers it.
